label: Rat CA1 pyramidal cell
description: NeuroMorpho.Org n120 (Turner archive, CC BY 4.0): a rat hippocampal CA1 pyramidal cell with basal and apical dendrites, 2,630 samples.
expectedResult: Basal and apical dendrites in 3D; 11.9 mm of dendrite, 75 bifurcations and a Sholl peak of 46 intersections at 40 µm.

label: Rat dentate gyrus basket cell
description: NeuroMorpho.Org 5-27-11cell1-nonFS-BC (Santhakumar archive, CC BY 4.0): a rat dentate basket cell with dendrites and a complete axon.
expectedResult: Axon and dendrites coloured apart; 7.8 mm of neurite, 51 bifurcations and a Sholl peak of 30 at 120 µm.
